# Malformed Mach-O fixture directory
# These will be generated by the build_fixtures.sh script or manually crafted.
# Used for parser hardening and defensive engineering.
#
# Examples to create:
# - truncated_header: first 16 bytes of a real Mach-O (header cut short)
# - bad_magic: file starting with 0xDEADBEEF
# - overlapping_segments: valid header but segment vmaddr ranges overlap
# - bogus_symoff: symtab offset pointing past end of file
